descripcion:
Cancel Amazon Prime: why was it so hard? In its June 2023 complaint, the FTC alleged that Amazon's own internal name for its Prime cancellation flow was "Iliad", after the long Greek epic. Per the complaint, it was a four-page, six-click, fifteen-option process. Signing up took one or two clicks.

How did it end? On Sep 25, 2025 the FTC announced a $2.5 billion settlement with Amazon: a $1 billion civil penalty and $1.5 billion in refunds for an estimated 35 million consumers. Amazon did not admit the allegations.

The screens in this video are illustrations of the flow the complaint describes, not real screenshots.

Sources: FTC v. Amazon complaint, Jun 21, 2023 (allegations, as reported by AP); FTC press release, Sep 25, 2025.
